mapper.select: SELECT /* homes.broker.mapper.BrokerComplexMapper.selectComplexList */ A.HBD_CPLX_NO , A.HBD_CPLX_SEQ , A.ARCD , A.LEGCD , A.CPLX_NM , 'CPX999' AS CPLX_TY , ( SELECT CODE_NM FROM TB_CM_COMMCODE WHERE GRP_CD = 'CPX' AND COMM_CD = '999' ) AS CPLX_TY_NM , A.CPLX_HSHLD_CO , A.CPLX_DONG_CO FROM TB_HBD_COMPLEX A WHERE A.ARCD = #{arcd} AND A.LEGCD = #{legcd} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 'X' FROM TB_BRK_COMPLEX CPX WHERE A.HBD_CPLX_NO = CPX.HBD_CPLX_NO AND A.HBD_CPLX_SEQ = CPX.HBD_CPLX_SEQ AND CPX.BRKNO = #{brkno} ) UNION ALL SELECT /* homes.broker.mapper.BrokerComplexMapper.selectComplexList */ A.HBD_CPLX_NO , A.HBD_CPLX_SEQ , A.ARCD , A.LEGCD , A.CPLX_NM , A.CPLX_TY , B.CODE_NM AS CPLX_TY_NM , A.CPLX_HSHLD_CO , A.CPLX_DONG_CO FROM TB_BRK_COMPLEX A INNER JOIN TB_CM_COMMCODE B ON A.CPLX_TY = B.MXTR_COMM_CD WHERE A.ARCD = #{arcd} AND A.LEGCD = #{legcd} AND A.BRKNO = #{brkno}
